# Writing Plan — CoRL 2026
# Paper: Diagnostic Analysis of Temporal Abstraction in World-Model RL
# Deadline: 2026-05-29 (14 days from today)
# Format: 8 pages + references
# Last updated: 2026-05-15

venue:
  name: CoRL 2026
  deadline: 2026-05-29
  format: "8 pages + unlimited references"
  template: corl2026  # IEEE two-column
  positioning: diagnostic-analysis  # NOT method paper

# ============================================================
# PAPER STRUCTURE
# ============================================================

sections:
  - id: abstract
    title: Abstract
    target_words: 200
    content_outline: |
      Temporal abstraction via variable-dt imagination in world-model RL (DreamerV3) consistently degrades performance.
      We conduct a factorial diagnostic isolating trained dt_embedding as the reliable trigger for pathological value
      overestimation (nve>1.5x, 4/4 separating power across seeds). Collapse is stochastic (seed-dependent), but the
      diagnostic marker is deterministic. Practical mitigation: restrict imagination to dt=1 during multi-dt training
      → 95% baseline recovery with cross-seed consistency (869.9±0.01 vs baseline 915.67).
    claims_referenced: [C1, C2, C3, C6]
    data_ready: true
    writing_order: 8  # last

  - id: introduction
    title: Introduction
    target_pages: 1.0
    content_outline: |
      (1) Temporal abstraction is a long-sought goal; world-model RL offers natural testbed via imagination dt.
      (2) Puzzle: all variable-rate attempts degrade. TAWM shows Δt conditioning works in MPC — why does it fail
      in imagination-based actor-critic?
      (3) Contribution: closed causal chain (trained dt_emb → nve>1.5x → stochastic collapse) + practical mitigation
      (dt=1 imagination, 95% recovery). Diagnostic methodology with factorial design.
      (4) Scope: DreamerV3/RSSM, Walker Walk (+ cross-env if ready).
    claims_referenced: [C1, C2, C6]
    key_references: [hafner2023dreamerv3, nhu2025tawm, lu2018nondelusional, gumbsch2024thick]
    data_ready: true
    writing_order: 6

  - id: related_work
    title: Related Work
    target_pages: 1.0
    content_outline: |
      (1) Temporal abstraction in RL: options (Sutton 1999), FiGAR, TempoRL, SDAR — all model-free.
      (2) World-model RL & imagination: DreamerV1-V4, IRIS, TWM — standard dt=1 imagination.
      (3) Variable-rate world models: TAWM (MPC, beneficial), THICK/Hieros (hierarchy), MTS3, LS-Imagine.
      (4) Value overestimation in MBRL: MBPO, MOPO, delusional bias (Lu 2018), MAD-TD.
      (5) Diagnostic methodology precedent: Implementation Matters, What Matters for Actor-Critic.
      Differentiate from TAWM (MPC vs imagination paradigm — opposite conclusions on Δt conditioning).
    claims_referenced: []
    key_references: [sutton1999options, sharma2017figar, biedenkapp2021temporl, hafner2023dreamerv3,
                     nhu2025tawm, gumbsch2024thick, mattes2024hieros, shaj2023mts3, li2025lsimagine,
                     janner2019mbpo, yu2020mopo, lu2018nondelusional, su2020conqur,
                     engstrom2020implementation, andrychowicz2021whatmatters, frauenknecht2025rollouts]
    data_ready: true
    writing_order: 7

  - id: methodology
    title: "Experimental Setup"
    target_pages: 1.5
    content_outline: |
      (1) DreamerV3 base architecture (RSSM, symlog, discrete latents) — brief, cite original.
      (2) Variable-rate imagination mechanism: dt_embedding (trained/untrained/removed), temporal subsampling,
      imagination horizon H. How each factor modifies imagination rollouts.
      (3) Factorial design: 2×2×2 grid (dt_emb training × subsample × H) + fixed-dt baselines + mitigation.
      Present grid as table with cell assignments.
      (4) Diagnostic metrics: eval return, v/e ratio, normalized v/e (nve = exp_v/e / baseline_v/e at same step),
      nve>1.5x threshold, RSSM fidelity (obs_MSE, reward_MAE at dt=1 vs dt=2).
      (5) Environment: Walker Walk (DMC), 500K baseline / 105K treatments, 2+ seeds per config.
    claims_referenced: [C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6]
    key_references: [hafner2023dreamerv3, agarwal2021precipice]
    data_ready: true
    writing_order: 2

  - id: results
    title: Results
    target_pages: 2.5
    content_outline: |
      Organized by findings (F1-F6 mapping to C1-C6):
      F1 (C1): All dt>1 degrade — learning curves overlay (exp_001, 005, 006, 007).
      F2 (C2): Trained dt_emb → nve>1.5x (4/4 separation). 008d vs 008f causal control.
      Stochastic collapse: 008d seed 1 sustained nve>1.5x → collapse; 009b seed 2 transient → self-correction.
      F3 (C3): Untrained dt_emb prevents drift — 008a@105K=778, nve 0.59-0.93x.
      F4 (C4): dt=2 > dt=4 monotonic degradation.
      F5 (C5): Horizon/subsample secondary — 008c (H=8) vs 008a (H=15).
      F6 (C6): dt=1 imagination mitigation — 008e_v3@105K=869.9 (95% baseline), cross-seed consistent (s0≈s1).
    claims_referenced: [C1, C2, C3, C4, C5, C6]
    experiments_required:
      - exp_001_baseline  # DONE
      - exp_005_event_gated_v4  # DONE
      - exp_006_fixed_dt2  # DONE
      - exp_007_fixed_dt4  # DONE
      - exp_008a_no_subsample_dt2  # DONE
      - exp_008c_no_subsample_dt2_h8  # DONE
      - exp_008d_subsample_on_h8  # DONE
      - exp_008e_v3_subsample_on_dt1_h15  # DONE
      - exp_008f_no_dt_embed_subsample_on_h8  # DONE
      - exp_009b_008d_walker_s2  # DONE
      - exp_009c_008f_walker_s2  # DONE
      - exp_008e_v3_walker_s1  # DONE
      - exp_008e_v3_walker_s2  # RUNNING
      - exp_009a_baseline_walker_s2  # RUNNING
    data_ready: partial  # 008e_v3_s2 and baseline_s2 still running
    writing_order: 1  # write first — data-rich, anchors everything

  - id: analysis
    title: "Analysis & Discussion"
    target_pages: 1.5
    content_outline: |
      (1) Mechanism: trained dt_emb enables reward head to produce systematically biased dt>1 predictions
      (reward gap 2.78x in 008d). Critic trained on these → optimistic value landscape → actor exploitation.
      RSSM fidelity table: absolute errors + ratios side-by-side.
      (2) Stochastic collapse: why sustained vs transient nve>1.5x diverges (plasticity, primacy bias).
      Connect to Zhang 2026, Lyle 2022, Bjorck 2022.
      (3) Why MPC is immune: TAWM uses Δt conditioning successfully because MPC re-plans from real states.
      Imagination-based training accumulates value error across full rollout → exploit.
      (4) 008f trade-off: removing dt_emb eliminates delusional critic but destroys reward prediction (75x MAE).
      008e_v3 as the correct fix (keeps trained dt_emb, restricts imagination to dt=1).
      (5) Implications: current RSSM insufficient for dt>1 imagination; hierarchy (THICK, Hieros) as correct direction.
    claims_referenced: [C2, C3, C6]
    key_references: [nhu2025tawm, lu2018nondelusional, zhang2026instability, lyle2022capacity,

writing_order:
  - order: 1
    section: results
    reason: "Data-rich, anchors all other sections. Most figures/tables go here."
    blocker: null

  - order: 2
    section: methodology
    reason: "Defines experiment design referenced by results. Can write in parallel with results."
    blocker: null

  - order: 3
    section: analysis
    reason: "Interprets results, requires results section to be stable."
    blocker: results

  - order: 4
    section: related_work
    reason: "literature_map complete (72 papers). Position against TAWM, THICK, Hieros."
    blocker: null  # can write early

  - order: 5
    section: introduction
    reason: "Frames contributions — needs results and analysis solidified."
    blocker: [results, analysis]

  - order: 6
    section: conclusion
    reason: "Summarizes; last content section."
    blocker: [results, analysis]

  - order: 7
    section: abstract
    reason: "Written last, distills entire paper."
    blocker: [introduction, results, analysis, conclusion]
